card.name: Partway through drug names and list items
card.fires_on: Fires on a word-start piece partway through a drug name (am|photericin, cann|abidiol, Dip|ropionate), and on a few list or section-number spots in drug-label text.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Early or middle piece of a longer drug name, often after a drug-interaction or hypersensitivity phrase.

modes.label: Numbering and list links
modes.description: Section numbers, spaces in reference lists, or small words introducing a contraindicated condition.

card.writes: It seems to steer away from common next pieces and favours rare name-starting pieces; no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long drug names and in small spots within label lists and section numbers.
